reviewed_by: Codex review of nebula-v3.0.12 matrix gate failure and GitHub Actions 256-job limit
reason: The accepted daily release coverage contained 285 entries, but GitHub allows at most 256 jobs in one matrix, so the browser job could not schedule and the release gate failed. The same reviewed selection is partitioned into four 200-entry matrices, each retaining its exact project, test, grep, runtime, and shard. The gate now requires every nonempty matrix; the daily preflight rejects more than 800 entries before creating an immutable tag. Five focused Python cases verify lane conservation, output encoding, workflow gate wiring, and both preflight paths.
exclusions: The diff changes only release coverage scheduling and exact selector checks. No operator UI or product runtime code changed. The current candidate stopped before browser execution, and the next immutable candidate will run its already-reviewed change-aware browser journeys. Browser, frontend, native, unrelated Python tests, and the full suite are excluded from this PR.
